prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Adopt or create a custom pet that lives right on your desktop while you work or play."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_pet_arrival", "home_intro"], "new_pet_arrival": {"headline": "Your Pet is Arriving!", "body": "Watch your pet land safely onto your desktop toolbar.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your New Pet", "body": "Select a friendly companion to join you on your desktop."}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive pet traits quiz flow: Insert a new interactive personality quiz screen into the path selection flow to guide users to their ideal pet path.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_personality_quiz", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_personality_quiz": {"headline": "What kind of pet companion fits your daily routine?", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Generating Your Unique Companion...", "body": "This usually takes about 1-2 minutes. Please keep the app open."}}
5: [finish, hint] Desktop placement helper hint on home intro: Add a persistent helper hint box on the home_intro screen explaining how pet controls and desktop visibility work.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Look for your pet near your taskbar. Right-click the pet anytime to open quick controls or hide it.", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Friend!"}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Simplified single sign-in callout copy: Update sign_in copy to clearly state that signing in saves your desktop pet to your cloud account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet to Account", "body": "Sign in now so your desktop pet status and custom traits are permanently saved across sessions.", "button_label": "Sign In to Save"}}
7: [home, notification] Background generation ready notification toggle: Add a system notification option on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generates.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Photo upload guidance and quality incentive hint: Add helpful photo quality tips and visual guidance on upload_photos screen to improve creation success.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting!", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo"}}
9: [sign_in, redesign] Compact step counter redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign sign_in layout to compact style with step counter display to reassure users sign-in is quick.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Quick Account Sign-In"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen layout while preserving its core function of introducing the desktop pet.
Adds a new pet arrival preview screen inside onboarding before home intro without removing any required steps.
Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a grid layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Adds a personality quiz screen within the onboarding flow while keeping all base onboarding steps intact.
Adds a progress indicator and time estimate for a real generation wait on the waiting screen.
Adds a helpful taskbar placement hint on the home intro screen.
Updates sign-in copy to explain account saving without altering required functionality or violating copy rules.
Adds a desktop notification option on the waiting screen while pet generation takes place.
Adds helpful photo quality tips on the upload photos screen without introducing dark patterns.
Redesigns the sign-in screen to a compact layout with a step counter while retaining the sign-in step.
